- `unitNormQuotientMap_apply` rewrites the map applied to `u` into the coerced class of `(u : Kˣ)`. It is a canonical evaluation rule and goes in the right direction. It cannot loop, because its right side no longer mentions `unitNormQuotientMap`. The definition is not @[simp]-unfolded, so there is no unwanted expansion.

Both are applied by `rw`, so they compose without conflict.
